messages.subject: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat error
parts:
Hello,
I want to use MSstats to analyse an experiment, but I'm struggling to get it into the right format with MaxQtoMSstatsFormat. It gets to a certain point then I get an error:

INFO  [2021-09-21 15:55:13] ** Run annotation merged with quantification data.
INFO  [2021-09-21 15:55:13] ** Features with one or two measurements across runs are removed.
INFO  [2021-09-21 15:55:13] ** Fractionation handled.
Error in setnames(x, value) : 
  Can't assign 4 names to a 0 column data.table

I've attached my annotation file below, can someone check that the problem doesn't lie there? The evidence and proteingroups files are straight from maxquant. The experimental design is that I have two genes, P and K, which are either wildtype or knockout (DMSO or RAP). I have three replicates of these four conditions. The experiment is label free. My R code is:

MaxQtoMSstatsFormat('evidence.txt', 
      'annotationfile.csv',
      'proteinGroups.txt',
      proteinID="Proteins", 
      useUniquePeptide=TRUE, 
      removeProtein_with1Peptide=FALSE)

Any help would be appreciated!

Thanks,
Heledd

messages.author: 5c6e92c10ef28984
messages.subject: Re: MaxQtoMSstatsFormat error
parts:
Hi,


data.table::fread function which we use to read text file treats the Intensity column as integer64 type. Please
- read the evidence files outside of the converter function,
- run evidence$Intensity <- as.numeric(evidence$Intensity) before passing evidence to the converter function.
This should solve the problem. We will fix this in the next release of MSstats.


Kind regards,
Mateusz
